title: Normalized Hom comparison from scalar telescopes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with an ordinary derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ and localization functor $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], countable coproducts, and filtered colimits indexed by small categories, which are exact. Let $\mathcal B$ be a category and $F:D(\mathcal A)\rightleftarrows\mathcal B:U$ an adjunction with unit $\eta$. Fix $p\in\mathbf N$. For every complex $C$, let $T_p(C)$ be the sequential complex diagram with constant object $C$ and transition $p\operatorname{id}_C$. Suppose specified isomorphisms $\beta_C:Q(\operatorname{colim}T_p(C))\simeq UF(QC)$ satisfy $Q(\iota_{C,0})\beta_C=\eta_{QC}$. Let $H:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ be additive, let $G$ be an endofunctor of complexes, and fix $e:QG\simeq HQ$. For a complex $P$, suppose the canonical comparison $Q(\operatorname{colimit.post}(T_p(P),G))$ is invertible. Then there is an isomorphism $t:UF(H(QP))\simeq H(UF(QP))$ satisfying $\eta_{H(QP)}t=H(\eta_{QP})$. The only continuity hypothesis is the comparison for this one diagram and complex. If U is full, the same continuity comparison is invertible for every strictly bounded-below complex, L is bounded below, and H(UFL) is isomorphic to a restricted object, then any map UF(HL) → H(UFL) whose composite with the unit is H(η_L) is invertible.

proof.text: Use additivity and the representative natural isomorphism to identify the scalar transitions after Q. Exact sequential colimits and their telescope triangles give an isomorphism of derived colimits preserving their legs.
Compose with the assumed canonical continuity comparison, the natural model isomorphism, and the two unit-normalized telescope isomorphisms. Naturality gives the stated zeroth-leg equation.

Choose a strictly bounded-below representative of L and apply the telescope comparison. Transport its isomorphism using unit naturality. Fullness of U makes precomposition with the unit injective on morphisms into a restricted object, so the transported isomorphism equals the specified normalized comparison.

theorem scalarTelescope_hom_comparison
    {A : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableCoproducts A] [HasFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} A]
    [AB5OfSize.{0, 0} A]
    {B : Type b} [Category.{h} B]
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ B) (U : B ⥤ DerivedCategory A) (adj : F ⊣ U)
    (p : ℕ) (G : CochainComplex A ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (H : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory A) [H.Additive]
    (e : G ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ H)
    (β : ∀ P : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (colimit (Functor.ofSequence (fun _ : ℕ ↦ p • 𝟙 P))) ≅
        U.obj (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
    (hβ : ∀ P : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (colimit.ι (Functor.ofSequence (fun _ : ℕ ↦ p • 𝟙 P)) 0) ≫ (β P).hom =
        adj.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
    (P : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (hcont : IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map
      (colimit.post (Functor.ofSequence (fun _ : ℕ ↦ p • 𝟙 P)) G))) :
    ∃ t : U.obj (F.obj (H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))) ≅
        H.obj (U.obj (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))),
      adj.unit.app (H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫ t.hom =
        H.map (adj.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
